summary: The visible suite now passes (3 passed). I changed only `solution/core.py`. The cause was that the VM read binary operands in reverse. `pop()` returns the top of the stack first, so the top value is the right operand, but the code treated it as the left one. That made SUB, LT, and GT compute the wrong result, which kept the countdown loop from ever reaching zero and hit the step limit. I changed the operand order to left-then-right for ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV, MOD, EQ, LT, and GT. The divide-by-zero check now tests the divisor (the top value) rather than the dividend, which is why `DIV`/`MOD` by zero didn't raise. I also fixed SWAP, which had the same inversion and was leaving the stack unchanged; the visible tests don't cover it, so that fix is by reading the code. The public API in `solution/__init__.py` is untouched, and nothing under `tests/` was modified.
